narrative: Flowise CVE-2026-40933 (CVSS 9.9) runs a one-click chatflow import as code with the host process's own privileges, no confinement. Obsidian argues the stdio transport exists to execute code, so the enforcement point must be the runtime that launches and confines the tool. Coming a week after the Langroid flaw, two framework RCEs make this the pressure forcing a containment posture.
remaining_gap: No peer agent-harness vendor has yet published a matching gVisor/OS-sandbox/VM containment spec, and no standards body has drafted a profile.
